h: A Black Country town centre stop
p: Bilston sits between Wolverhampton and Wednesbury, and Church Street is part of its compact, no-nonsense town centre, with the market and a run of everyday shops all within a few minutes' walk.

There's a handy extra way in beyond the buses: the West Midlands Metro tram stops at Bilston Central, linking the town with Wolverhampton one way and Birmingham the other. That makes it easy to combine a visit with a trip into either city. Remember this is an adult gaming centre, so it's 18+ only and no place for the kids. If you're hungry, the town centre has the usual Black Country mix of bakeries, chippies and cafés, perfect for a cheap and cheerful bite.
